purpose: Freeze one source-complete raw-base compound-port boundary for future implementation without authorizing code execution, raw reads, solver runs, truth, accuracy, or publication.

decision.reason: Station reference, satellite-state timing, Sagnac/geometry, atmosphere, TGD/BGD policy, smoothing, interpolation, and exact code-factor miss population are coupled in the official base operator; no individual knob can establish source parity.

official_pipeline_contract.entry: official preprocessing selects a base RINEX member and trims it to rover span plus 180 seconds; correct_pseudorange receives rover/base observations and broadcast nav
official_pipeline_contract.station_reference: official source computes mean base_position.csv XYZ and calls base_offset.csv ENU offset after obsb.residuals(satb); these tables are forbidden in Phase126
official_pipeline_contract.signal_key: same satellite and exact selected signal/frequency stream; official helper loops L1/L5
official_pipeline_contract.satellite_state: source-equivalent RTKLIB satposs at signal transmission time; dts is m, ddts is m/s, health is explicit, TGD/BGD is not included in dts
official_pipeline_contract.geometry: source-equivalent ECEF geodist range and LOS with Sagnac exactly once
official_pipeline_contract.atmosphere: source-equivalent RTKLIB ionmodel and tropmodel at the base reference and selected signal frequency
official_pipeline_contract.base_residual_formula: resPc_b = P_b - (rho_b - dts_b + ionosphere_b + troposphere_b) = P_b + dts_b - rho_b - ionosphere_b - troposphere_b
official_pipeline_contract.rover_application_formula: resPc_r_corrected = resPc_r - pc; pc = linear_in_domain(interpolate(base_time, centered_movmean(resPc_b, window)))

smoothing.edge_policy: centered moving mean with source-equivalent finite/NaN edge behavior

official_pipeline_contract.interpolation: linear only between finite source samples at rover GPST; outside domain, missing stream, duplicate time, or nonfinite value is a miss
official_pipeline_contract.missing_policy: official nonfinite resPc does not create a pseudorange factor; no endpoint hold, nearest fill, extrapolation, gap bridge, or repair
official_pipeline_contract.tgd_bgd_policy: official resPc has no explicit TGD/BGD term; any source-complete native implementation must apply this policy symmetrically to rover and base or fail closed

native_difference_summary.native: RINEX signal policy selects primary/secondary bands; Android parser admits explicit source signal/frequency
native_difference_summary.compound_requirement: source-vector tests must prove exact allowed signal/FCN key set; additional-band selector is excluded

native_difference_summary.official: satposs with receiver-clock-adjusted P, source transmission time, metre-valued dts, no TGD/BGD in dts
native_difference_summary.native: two-pass P/c then satellite-clock time in base and rover
native_difference_summary.compound_requirement: choose one source-equivalent state/clock contract and reject mixed or missing state

native_difference_summary.native: explicit satellite rotation followed by calculateGeometry
native_difference_summary.compound_requirement: prove one Sagnac application with a synthetic source vector; double rotation fails closed
prove finite value equivalence for nav/time/elevation/frequency or reject the route

native_difference_summary.official: P + dts - rho - ionosphere - troposphere; no explicit TGD/BGD in resPc
native_difference_summary.native: P + dts - rho - ionosphere - troposphere - group_delay for rover and base
native_difference_summary.compound_requirement: port/prove symmetric official no-explicit-TGD/BGD semantics; no rover-only/base-only TGD switch

native_difference_summary.official: sameSat, centered movmean 151/11, linear interp1 at rover times
native_difference_summary.native: (SatelliteId,SignalType) stream, centered finite mean, strict in-domain correctionAt
native_difference_summary.compound_requirement: canonical GPST, exact endpoint/gap/NaN semantics, and per-signal conservation proof

atomic_implementation_steps.name: raw-ingress-and-reference
atomic_implementation_steps.scope: Hash-bound raw base RINEX/header, raw signal/FCN/frequency/time canonicalization, finite Earth-valid station reference, broadcast-nav availability and route interval/coverage checks.

atomic_implementation_steps.name: official-base-correction-stream
atomic_implementation_steps.scope: One source-equivalent satellite-state, clock, Sagnac/geometry, atmosphere, residual, smoothing, exact-stream and in-domain interpolation operator; official TGD/BGD policy is symmetric or the route fails.

atomic_implementation_steps.name: exactly-once-application-and-structural-verifier
atomic_implementation_steps.scope: Apply only finite source corrections to raw code factors once, conserve keys/counts, retain all Phase112/118 graph state and solver invariants, and emit opaque structural telemetry only.

acceptance_invariants.lineage: exactly one raw phone GNSS/IMU, broadcast nav, and declared hash-bound raw base RINEX; no forbidden path/token or side channel
acceptance_invariants.station: header XYZ finite and Earth-valid; antenna convention proven; no table, phone, result, PDC, or precomputed coordinate
acceptance_invariants.observation: finite metre P, exact satellite/signal key, valid frequency/wavelength/FCN, deterministic tracking selection, canonical GPST
acceptance_invariants.satellite_state: finite source-equivalent position/clock and healthy ephemeris at source-equivalent transmission time; one geometry/Sagnac evaluation
acceptance_invariants.atmosphere_and_units: clock/range/atmosphere/correction are metres; no hidden seconds conversion; official no-TGD/BGD policy symmetric
acceptance_invariants.stream: same-satellite/same-signal only; MTV-A 1 s/151 and LAX-T 15 s/11; source-equivalent centered edge/NaN policy
acceptance_invariants.interpolation: finite in-domain linear only; no extrapolation, endpoint hold, nearest fill, gap repair, or adaptive window
acceptance_invariants.conservation: original_code_rows = retained_rows + missing_stream_rows + out_of_domain_rows + nonfinite_rows per signal and globally
acceptance_invariants.exactly_once: source model build count 1, correction application pass count 1, duplicate marker rejected before mutation
acceptance_invariants.graph: P-only measurement correction; no base factor/new variable; C7/D/CCDD units/key order, QR, IMU/carrier/TDCP/Doppler topology, filter/noise/LM/initialization/offset unchanged
acceptance_invariants.structural_routes: MTV-A and LAX-T each require GNSS-first/main progress, finite strict cost decrease, full finite exact C7/D handoff, finite earth-valid output coverage, and no fallback
